meta.title: Mini-IDP Schmidt: test plan
meta.hinweis: Every case sent a real file through the real workflow with curl. Slack answers were given by hand. Runs took place on 28 October 2026 with fictional delivery notes. Durations of human cases include the time until the Slack answer. The notes in the workflow and the Slack texts are German, the language of the course project.

goals: Clean notes run on free OCR only

groups.title: Normal delivery notes
groups.text: Are clean, handwritten and foreign-format notes read correctly, and does the cheapest way run first?

groups.title: Wrong documents and broken files
groups.text: Is advertising or a tax notice never booked as a delivery note, and does a broken file end in the error path?

groups.title: Rules ask a human
groups.text: Do the fixed rules notice a missing field or a wrong sum and ask a person with the reason in plain words?

groups.title: What the human can answer
groups.text: Does each answer (approve, correct, reject) end where the rules say, and is every correction logged?

groups.title: Duplicates
groups.text: Is the same delivery note never stored twice, and is nobody asked about a duplicate?

cases.title: Clean printed note stays on free OCR
cases.input: L1: a clean printed delivery note from a fictional office supplier, 4 items, all fields present.
cases.expect: All fields read by OCR alone, no AI call, saved without a human. Cost 0 $.
cases.source: Expected values read from the image by hand (Soll_L1-L3.json)
cases.result: Stage OCR, result saved, 0 $, 17.4 s, no AI.

cases.title: Handwritten note goes to Haiku and gemma4
cases.input: L2: a freight forwarder's note with five handwritten remarks and a driver signature, 3 items.
cases.expect: OCR is not sure, so Haiku reads the image and gemma4 confirms the values. Saved.
cases.source: Expected values read from the image by hand (Soll_L1-L3.json)
cases.result: Stage Prüfer (Haiku, then gemma4), saved. 2,353 tokens in, 462 out, 0.0047 $, 96.1 s.
cases.note: The long duration includes the cold start of the local model (about a minute).

cases.title: US note: date format, gallons, English
cases.input: L3: a note from a US supplier with a US date, gallons and rolls, 4 items.
cases.expect: Fields read as on the note, date converted to the German format. Saved.
cases.source: Expected values read from the image by hand (Soll_L1-L3.json)
cases.result: Stage Prüfer, saved. 2,353 tokens in, 443 out, 0.0046 $, 35.4 s.

cases.title: Advertising PDF is not booked
cases.input: T10: a PDF with a promotional mail instead of a delivery note.
cases.expect: Recognised as no delivery note, goes to the clarification queue, nothing booked.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run (Testbelege README)
cases.result: Stage OCR, result clarification, reason "not a delivery note (detected: unknown)", 0 $, 0.3 s.

cases.title: Tax notice is not booked
cases.input: T04: a sample tax notice with amounts, as a PNG.
cases.expect: Document type "notice" is recognised, clarification queue, nothing booked.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run (Testbelege README)
cases.result: Stage Prüfer, result clarification, reason "not a delivery note (detected: notice)", 0.0029 $, 23.2 s.

cases.title: Broken image ends in the error path
cases.input: T12: a JPG that cannot be opened.
cases.expect: The error path catches it, a row is written, the run does not crash.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run (Testbelege README)
cases.result: Stage OCR, result error, reason "file not readable", 0 $, 1.5 s. A cost row was written.

cases.how: Real file plus a real Slack message
cases.title: Missing order number and date are noticed
cases.input: L4 (LS-2026-04911): order number and delivery date are empty on the note.
cases.expect: The model returns empty fields and invents nothing. The required-field rule asks a human, naming both fields.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run; required fields are supplier, note number, order number, delivery date
cases.result: Slack message "Action required: check" with the note image and the reasons "order number missing" and "delivery date missing". Read by Haiku, checked by gemma4, 0.0036 $.

cases.how: Real file plus a real Slack message
cases.title: Items do not add up to the printed total
cases.expect: The sum rule finds the contradiction and asks a human. No AI needed.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run; sum check in the code node Regeln prüfen
cases.result: Slack message with the reason "Sum of items 570 ≠ total 640". Read by OCR only, 0 $.

cases.title: Correct the missing fields
cases.input: L4: in the form, choose Correct and enter order number BST-48099 and delivery date 19.05.2026.
cases.expect: The rules run again, the note is saved with the human values, both changes are logged as old → new.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run
cases.result: Saved, release "human (corrected)". Logged: order number empty → BST-48099, delivery date empty → 19.05.2026 (2 changes). Slack message sent, 136.8 s.

cases.title: Reject an unusable note
cases.input: L4: in the form, choose Reject with a comment.
cases.expect: Nothing is saved, the note goes to the clarification queue with status rejected.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run
cases.result: Queue row with status rejected and the comment as reason. Slack message "rejected", 88 s.

cases.title: Approve although the fields are still empty
cases.input: L4: in the form, choose Approve without entering the missing values.
cases.expect: Approval does not skip the rules. The note ends in the clarification queue.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run; the rules run again after the form
cases.result: Clarification, reason "required field missing despite the human's decision: order number, delivery date". Nothing saved.
cases.note: The duration of 1,586 s is the time until the click, not processing time.

cases.title: Correct a wrong quantity
cases.input: L5: in the form, choose Correct and change position 3 from 500 to 570.
cases.expect: The sum now fits (640). The note is saved and the change is logged.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run
cases.result: Saved, release "human (corrected)", reason "corrected: position 3: 500 → 570". Correction row with comment, 83.6 s, 0 $.

cases.title: Reject the contradicting note
cases.input: L5: in the form, choose Reject.
cases.expect: Not saved, clarification queue with status rejected.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run
cases.result: Slack message "rejected", reason "rejected by a human: test: note unusable, ask the supplier", 65.5 s, 0 $.

cases.title: Approve although the sum is still wrong
cases.input: L5: in the form, choose Approve with the sum unchanged.
cases.expect: The rules run again and still see 570 ≠ 640. The note ends in the clarification queue.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run
cases.result: Clarification, reason "sum of items 570 ≠ total 640 despite the human's decision". Queue row written, 133.9 s, 0 $.

cases.title: Clean note sent twice
cases.input: L1 sent a second time after it was saved.
cases.expect: The second run is flagged as duplicate, not stored again, no AI.
cases.source: Test plan written before the run (Testbelege README)
cases.result: Stage OCR, result duplicate, reason names supplier and note number, 0 $, 18 s.

cases.how: Real file plus a real Slack message
cases.title: Corrected note sent again, nobody is asked
cases.input: L5 sent again after the corrected version was saved.
cases.expect: Found as duplicate before the Slack action, so no question is sent. Only a message.
cases.source: Design: duplicate check before the Slack action (block 7)
cases.result: Slack message "duplicate" with the reason "already stored", no button. Stage OCR, 0 $, 16.1 s.

cases.title: Delivery note as a PDF with a text layer
cases.input: A real delivery note as PDF. All test notes so far were images.
cases.expect: The text is taken straight from the PDF path, without Tesseract.
cases.note: The PDF path was built but never fed a real delivery note.

cases.title: Rule for handwritten remarks
cases.input: L2 again, to check the rule that handles remarks on the note.
cases.expect: The remarks are read and the note is routed by the rule.
cases.source: Design: rules in the code node Regeln prüfen
cases.note: Not exercised in the final test round.
